entities.summary: Ilha Grande, or "big island", is a 193 km2 (75 sq mi) forested island located around 12 km off of the Atlantic coast of Angra dos Reis, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and about 243 km from São Paulo. The highest point on Ilha Grande is the 1,031 m (3,383 ft) tall Pico da Pedra D'Água.
